deviations.detail: The launch record allowed only the console command. Keeping the report logic inside a Command would have made the required test — coverage content and exit behaviour — impossible without booting a console application.
deviations.resolution: The report is a plain class in src/Registry; the command finds the installed packages and presents it. The larena-specs launch record is amended with the same entry.
deviations.shape_impact: none: the report shape is the frozen one

deviations.detail: Named in the freeze as the structural descriptor check and listed in the launch record allowed files.
The declaration file is YAML, matching the existing api.yaml and access.yaml style, so larena/core now requires symfony/yaml ^7.4|^8.0 exactly as larena/rest does.
deviations.resolution: Declared in composer.json. composer could not install it into the package vendor tree — it cannot resolve this workspace's dev path repositories at all — so composer.lock is untouched and the tests and the analyser resolve the parser from the entry application, the way larena/access resolves larena/core for its own tests.
deviations.alternative_rejected: writing a YAML subset parser, or moving the declaration to JSON against the established descriptor style

deviations.detail: scanDirectories points at ../../app/vendor/symfony/yaml for the same reason.

The first closed key set for access.yaml and audit.yaml was derived from core and access alone and rejected nonclaims, allowed_payload_fields and forbidden_payload_fields, which six installed packages legitimately use.
deviations.resolution: The contract was widened to the keys actually in use, keeping the closed-set principle. Found by running the command against the root rather than by reading files.
deviations.shape_impact: none on the frozen shapes; the validator contract is not a frozen artifact

deviations.detail: larena/file-manager ships an access.yaml with no schema and no package key. Failing the coverage gate on it would make a Batch 3 gate red for pre-existing drift in a package outside this write boundary.
deviations.resolution: A missing schema is reported as a notice with reason code schema_absent, only list shapes are checked, and the finding is recorded for a later batch to own.
deviations.shape_impact: the report gains descriptor_file_notices beside the frozen keys

deviations.detail: The report first failed on an access operation code declared by a package with no scheduled registration batch. The freeze's exit-code rule says non-zero only on policy or descriptor-file violations.
deviations.resolution: The report fails only on descriptor violations and on an operation registered against an undeclared code. Gaps carry a scheduled or unscheduled state and a gap_counts summary.

deviations.detail: core.transport.invoke_remote appears in the feature specification but is not declared or registered, per the freeze's deferred_operations.

no_deviation_areas: the declaration schema, key sets, grammars, registry contract, rejection reasons, descriptor v2 rules, proposal receipt keys, approval digest algorithm, transport resolution order and gate order follow the freeze exactly
no public HTTP, REST or MCP surface
no change to any package other than larena/core
